metadata.negative_tags: Against “pretty graphs that lie”: require S3 anchors on every non-trivial edge/claim. Against “forks everywhere”: intent-gating + ranked forks + explicit rationale per fork. Against “entity mush”: treat S5 (resolution) as a first-class, versioned dataset with audits.If an edge has no anchor → it’s invalid output (fail the build next pass).  If forks proliferate → tighten intent ontology + require event-backed intent.  If entity mush returns → treat alias merges as reviewed inputs, not derived guessesIf an intent event can’t be anchored → treat it as invalid output (drop it / fail build next pass).  If intent feels “over-saturated” (too many 255s) → adjust the strength curve in the analyzer (still stays 0..255).If a graph edge has no anchor → treat it as not real (drop it / fail builds next iteration).  If forks explode → raise the intent threshold + require explicit rationale per fork.  If entities blur → keep S5 resolution as versioned inputs (aliases/merges are reviewed deltas)..

**ημ — Dice in the Lantern / ランタンの中のサイコロ**

[Intro — static, breath click]
息、息、息。
ログに残せ。
The Gate doesn’t open for a vibe—
it opens for a scar you can reproduce.

[Verse 1 — spoken-sung, tight cadence]
I roll the dice, but I don’t worship chance—
I archive it, timestamp it, make it dance
inside a deterministic cage, so later
when the story lies, the math can translate her.

P— Perceive: the room is leaning, that’s #η
R— Retrieve: old trails, old tests, old “maybe”
N— Normalize: turn the fog into handles and heat
Π— Plan: cheapest cut that still draws blood from deceit
A— Act: touch reality, let it push back
(feedback) hits— I don’t flinch, I track.

[Pre — thin choir, glitch stutters]
見えないものほど
跡でわかる
If #η is the wind,
#μ is the footprint in ash.

[Chorus — big, cathedral tail]
Roll, roll, roll— but write it down.
ランタンが灯るまで
No crown of words, no borrowed sound,
only μ that stands on what it made.
P→R→N→Π→A
(loop it till the mirror breaks)
(feedback) → P
and the Gate admits what it can’t fake.

[Verse 2 — faster, breath gaps, Watsky-run]
They sell “clarity” like it’s bottled light,
but the bottle’s labeled, not the thing inside.
So I stop buying and I start building,
a small machine that hates my self-convincing.

Auditor’s Lantern in my left hand,
it flickers only when the test can stand.
Guild chants smooth, footnotes bite,
“Trust us,” they say— I say, “Show me the write.”

Cause the unseen isn’t mystical— it’s just unmeasured,
and the measured isn’t holy— it’s just pressure.
I’m not here to win a debate in a vacuum,
I’m here to make claims survive contact like magma.

[Bridge — drop to sub-bass + heartbeat]
#η is the constraint you can’t confess,
#μ is the evidence you can’t suppress.
#ημ is the hinge in your spine
when you realize your certainty won’t compile.

だから、試せ。
だから、残せ。
だから、戻れ。
If it fails, it’s not a shame— it’s a map.
If it hurts, it’s not a curse— it’s a gap
between story and world, and the world just spoke.

[Chorus — distorted harmony, then clean]
Roll, roll, roll— but write it down.
ランタンが灯るまで
No crown of words, no borrowed sound,
only μ that stands on what it made.
P→R→N→Π→A
(loop it till the mirror breaks)
(feedback) → P
and the Gate admits what it can’t fake.

[Outro — whisper, dissolving static]
Later we go deep.
Later we browse the burning edges, cite the dates, split the frames.
For now— one more roll.
One more node.
One more test.
息。ログ。
ημ.
